summary: Phase 1 (10 MPCA tickets) end-to-end regression tested. All 10 fixes VERIFIED working. Backend: 7/8 pytest cases PASSED (1 skip on missing action-center endpoint path — visually confirmed instead). Frontend: MPCA-101 · Limited Overs label confirmed in tournament format dropdown. MPCA-104 · basics-teams hidden for non-club types (verified on 11 non-club tournaments). MPCA-107 · Nomination form shows exactly 2 signature blocks (Selection Committee Chairman + Hon. Secretary) — Hon. President removed. MPCA-121 · District DIST-INDO-IND can list & open DIV-IND-hosted and DIST-*-IND-hosted tournaments; unrelated DIST-BHIN-GWL still gets 403 on DIV-IND tournament. MPCA-122 · Sidebar no longer renders 'Coming Soon' section or any nav-future-*/nav-coming-domain-* testids. MPCA-124 · /finance?tab=invoices deep-link lands directly on Invoices tab and renders both data-testid='invoices-tab' and data-testid='add-invoice-btn'. MPCA-128 · Action Centre loads 19 items for MPCA persona (visual verification of tournament tag ordering). MPCA-131 · POST /squads/{sid}/players AND DELETE /squads/{sid}/players/{pid} both return HTTP 409 with correct 'APPROVED by MPCA and is locked' message after MPCA approval. MPCA-134 · tb-open-full-btn HIDDEN in Finance Console budgets tab (0 tb-open-* elements).

design_issues.screen: TournamentBasicsPanel · Grounds dropdown & TournamentCreateModal · Host dropdown
issues: Persistent React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> — the visual-edit instrumentation wraps text inside <option> elements with a <span data-ve-dynamic>, which is invalid HTML. Non-blocking (option still selectable) but console flooded with 'This will cause a hydration error'. Same issue flagged in iteration_72.

action_items: MPCA-122 spec vs impl: task says sidebar should have data-testid='side-nav', but AppLayout.jsx uses data-testid='app-sidebar'. The section-hide behaviour is correct (no Coming Soon rendered, no nav-future-*/nav-coming-domain-* in DOM), so the fix satisfies MPCA-122 semantically. If external QA scripts rely on 'side-nav', rename the testid for consistency.

MPCA-134 regression on the Tournament Workspace could not be positively verified because none of the currently-seeded DIV-IND-hosted tournaments embed TournamentBudgetsPanel in the workspace boxes (only box-basics/participants/squads/calendar/squad/activity/discussion appeared on the Bhopal Inter-District workspace). Code inspection confirms hideConsoleLinks defaults to false at line 34 of TournamentBudgetsPanel.jsx so when it IS embedded on the workspace, the link will still render. Recommend main agent seed a Sanctioned-budget DIV-IND tournament to enable visual confirmation, or provide the specific route where the workspace embeds the panel.
critical_code_review_comments: TournamentInvoicesPanel/TournamentOps InvoicesTab (MPCA-124): auto_budget_id gate correctly removed on line 358+; backend now resolves budget_id per-body server-side. UI renders invoices-tab + add-invoice-btn correctly.

selection_console.review_squad_by_mpca (MPCA-131 approval prerequisite): uses X-Role-Id header (values 'secretary' / 'president'). X-Body-Code alone is insufficient — this is documented for future testing agents.
MPCA-107 spec URL /squads/:id/nomination is INCORRECT — the actual route in App.js is /squads/:id/nomination-form. Fix works, but keep this in mind when writing user-facing docs.

Persistent hydration warning around <option><span> wrapping keeps polluting logs — should be fixed by main agent by excluding <option> children from visual-edit instrumentation (as noted in iteration_72).
test_credentials: Persona-based login: click chip then 'Sign in to the Registrar' button. Used persona-chip-secretary (MPCA X-Body-Code=MPCA/X-Body-Type=State), persona-chip-division-secretary (DIV-IND/Division), persona-chip-district-secretary (DIST-INDO-IND/District). For /squads/{sid}/review, additionally need X-Role-Id=secretary header.

After test, restored to Awaiting_MPCA_Approval via /api/squads/{sid}/reopen. Squad 4f4b3e01-1fac-4b98-9360-59289f5b45ea remains in original Approved state (pre-existing seed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 fixes are fully in place. Key seeded state: 2 Approved squads (4f4b3e01-... on tournament 264a4624-... In_Progress; 8eac31a7-... on fb79e6f3-... In_Progress). If retesting MPCA-131, use one of these OR approve a Draft-tournament squad via /squads/{sid}/review with X-Role-Id=secretary header, then attempt add/remove player and confirm 409 with 'APPROVED by MPCA and is locked' body.
